baslik: Russia's Mars Probe Fell Back to Earth

sahneler.metin: Russia's Mars 96 probe was launched toward Mars.
Within a day, it fell back into Earth's atmosphere and was destroyed.
The rocket reached a temporary orbit.
A second burn should have sent the probe on its way.
That burn did not happen as planned.
The probe was left stranded and re-entered.
It carried small plutonium power sources, never recovered.
The loss set back Russian planetary science for years.

aciklama:
Mars 96 re-entered the atmosphere instead of leaving for Mars. The cause: failure of the second burn of the upper stage, leaving the probe in Earth orbit.
